scope: Owned profile parsing, station request transactions, direct canonical station-driver and scan execution, WPS enrollee composition, key installation continuation, canonical RTOS clock/random pool, and shared cryptographic primitives. This is a source-only integration increment, not complete wireless CPU closure.

exact_source.fact: Apply-network dispatches the queued scan consumer only when supplicant exists.
Clear-connected requests disconnect only when supplicant state exceeds five.
Network selection dispatches the actual station request consumer.
Station join and leave use distinct queue kinds thirteen and fourteen.

Join removes the old profile and configures open/static WEP or personal WPA credentials. WEP accepts five/thirteen ASCII or ten/twenty-six hexadecimal bytes; sixty-four hexadecimal bytes encode a raw master key, otherwise personal passphrases derive a master key.
Association preparation sets privacy from WEP, WPS, or the selected pairwise cipher.
Association maps authentication, WPA version, pairwise/group selectors and key-management selectors before executing the lower driver CPU.
Remove and add key paths differ. Stock suppresses an add-key error for a nonbroadcast peer; the owned transaction preserves actual driver failure instead.
WPS configuration uses queue kind fifteen and separate progress/completion endpoints.
Station WPS dispatches PBC or bounded PIN configuration; broadcast BSSID means unspecified peer.
Personal master-key derivation uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1, 4096 iterations and thirty-two output bytes.
RFC 3394 unwrap verifies the eight-byte integrity register.
The RTOS random-byte source reads the low byte of a fresh system-time word for each output byte. It is not a hardware random-number generator.
Random generation XORs the tick bytes with sixteen-byte extractions from the thirty-two-word HMAC-SHA1 pool. The non-Linux pool-ready branch returns one without an entropy-strength test.

byte_observations.fact: The actual mailbox table maps kind sixteen to 0x013e0b18, whose exact consumer calls wpas_wps_cancel. The inferred add_default_network name at 0x013d8760 does not establish creation of a default profile.

The NONMATCHING lower add-key function zeroes sixty-four bytes, writes total length at zero, key flags at four, key length at eight, peer at twelve and material at thirty-two. Non-AP thirty-two-byte material swaps its final two eight-byte halves before invoking the owned selector. The sequence pointer is not copied into this request.
The NONMATCHING lower remove-key function builds a sixteen-byte request containing length, index and optional peer, then selects the mode-specific consumer.
The actual EAPOL receive extent was inspected as ARM instructions; the pinned C index has only an excluded header definition for this entry, so it is not claimed as exact C evidence.

reproduction.image: Owner-supplied X-M1 1.50 overlay image mapped at 0x01100000

owned_contract.execution: drive executes the concrete canonical StationDriver, including source-bound scan tokens and identified control completion. drive_with_clock additionally invokes the actual canonical RTOS slot_100 CPU and owned random pool. No production caller-supplied random-byte completion exists.
owned_contract.completion: StationCompletion identity is private and is published after actual transaction continuations, not queue acceptance. Cancellation retains the in-flight barrier before removal and disconnect.
owned_contract.shutdown: finish_shutdown produces a non-Clone private-identity SupplicantStopped receipt only after disconnected/cancelled completion, no pending/queued work, no installed keys, and no active supplicant/WPS state; it erases owned profiles and disables new submissions.
owned_contract.crypto: AES uses the shared xm1_wireless_crypto RustCrypto aes provider rather than secret-indexed tables. Shared providers are xm1_wireless_crypto and xm1_rtos_own_first. Handshake and WPS engine families are separate canonical source commits integrated by the parent.

remaining_cpu: Wire the canonical wireless_station_security.rs Michael-failure machine into runtime event draining, active EAPOL gating, reason-fourteen deauthentication and sixty-second resumption.
Wire upper supplicant authentication deadlines, ten seconds for personal authentication and seventy seconds for WPS after first EAPOL, to the actual clock/provider.
Complete association/EAPOL ordering protection when an indication or received frame precedes the pending driver continuation.
Compose the stopped receipt with RadioBoot's actual RTOS exit-semaphore, event/task deletion and stop acknowledgement lifecycle.
Root actor, canonical radio/adapter/clock providers, build graph and native entry composition remain integration-owner work.
security_limit: The source-bound tick/pool generator is not evidence of cryptographic entropy strength. No radio TRNG, host random source or environment callback is substituted for it.
verification: Pinned source/index and stated instruction extents were inspected. Behavioral tests were written but not run. No builds, tests, lint, formatter, native execution, SDK, camera, USB or radio operations were performed.
